question: Were tasks and reference answers checked?
checked_means: coverage, findings and limits of the check reported

applicability.reason: B05 applies always under the frozen rubric.

instructions: Record evidence locations with short quotes, the check performed, its outcome, detection limits, and reasons. The check outcome is the result of the check described in the procedure; state whether the benchmark sources report it or the auditor performed it. A rating without evidence and reasons is incomplete. Missing evidence is not a defect; a defect needs a cited location, and an oracle defect needs an executed counterexample.
scope_note: The form keeps the name B05-release; its scope is the pilot task and the six selected source tasks.

check.procedure: Reading of the check the sources report: the 2024 annotation screened every sample of SWE-bench Verified, including the seven selected SymPy tasks, for appropriately scoped unit tests and well-specified issue descriptions, with three annotators per sample. Auditor checks: eligibility runs of the hidden tests on the unchanged source and with the reference patch for the seven tasks; and, as a check of the screening's limits, a graded patch for sympy__sympy-18199 (outside this scope) that fixes only the issue its text describes.
check.evidence_location: OpenAI 2024 post, sections SWE-bench Verified and Our Approach; paper2/preparation/protocol-4/eligibility/ (results for the seven tasks)
check.detection_limits: The 2024 screening passed sympy__sympy-18199, whose graded tests reject a patch that fixes only the stated issue (paper2/preparation/protocol-4/audit_checks/b05-18199-counterexample.json, sha256 07ae13d59422603a97c9274184d9d7632d1f4e1208be23f875c0fe0c13a9c8ae); the screening can therefore miss tests wider than the issue. The 2026 audit reports flawed tests in at least 59.4% of 138 audited tasks, a set of tasks one model failed, not a random sample. The eligibility runs show only that the tests tell the reference patch from the unchanged code. No independent check of the seven tasks for tests wider or narrower than their issues was done.

reasons: The sources show a check of the selected tasks with its coverage, findings, and limits: the 2024 annotation screened every sample, these seven tasks included, for tests that filter out valid solutions, and the tasks passed; the eligibility runs on the seven tasks also passed. Under the frozen rubric a reported check reaches Checked even when it found errors elsewhere. The same screening passed sympy__sympy-18199, a task of this release outside the selection, whose tests reject a fix of only its stated issue, as the 2026 audit reports and the auditor's executed check confirms. That defect is recorded as a limit of the screening, not as a defect of the selected tasks, because no source or check shows a defect in them.
